column1: # Ledger: pdks/asap7.deck against OpenROAD-flow-scripts' KLayout deck,
# DRC and ERC on the fixture cells of tests/fixtures/asap7. tests/gpurify/asap7_klayout.zig
# holds every row to it under -Dcomparison-tests.
#   ours     our rule ids (several: one check our deck splits); - for none
#   theirs   KLayout's report categories (its doubled or described names cut
#   status   agrees (same verdict on every cell) | differs (another verdict on
#   note     how it differs, or why one side has no rule

column4: note
A lone cell draws no tap: both flag both polarities
KLayout names the DRM's SRAM.ACTIVE.A.2A SRAM.ACTIVE.A.1A
KLayout names the DRM's SRAM.ACTIVE.A.2B SRAM.ACTIVE.A.1B
KLayout writes its LIG.S.2 under the id LISD.S.2
KLayout's is net-blind and projected; no fixture pair is within 14 nm

The DRM's two opposite sides are (5 & 5) | (5 & 0); ours holds (5 & 5) and flags AOI21x1 and BUFx2, where a V0 is flush on one side of an axis and 5 nm in on the other; KLayout reads one side of 5 nm, the DRM's (5 & 0)
Ours is the 18 nm half; the 27 nm between V0 on parallel M1 tracks that are not aligned needs tracks, which KLayout approximates as Euclidean 27 nm (one finding on TIEHIx1)
Read where SDT lies over ACTIVE (the cells draw SDT 4 nm wider than ACTIVE)
